lines: By the sage Dvaipāyana this scripture
was expounded — measured by hundreds of thousands;
here liberation stands as the fruit —
l4.sanskrit_cite: dvaipāyanena muninā yadidaṃ vyadhāyi sāstraṃ sahasraśatasaṃmitamatra mokṣaḥ mādhānyataḥ phalatayā prathitastadanya- dharmādi tasya paripoṣayituṃ pragītam
